parts.title: Overview
parts.body:
Workers over 18 are usually entitled to 3 types of break:

  • rest breaks at work
  • daily rest

Rest breaks at work

Workers have the right to one uninterrupted 20 minute rest break during their working day, if they work more than 6 hours a day.

parts.title: Young workers
parts.body:
Young workers are usually entitled to:

  • a 30 minute rest break if they work more than 4.5 hours
